generatedBy: /audit skill v1.0 (Claude Opus 4.8, post-outage reliability frontier)

topline.theme: Two frontiers. (1) Reliability: today's full outage proved ~100 content/SEO gates were structurally blind to live availability — harden the edge deploy path so a bad Worker auto-recovers and is tested before it can hang prod. (2) Funnel: the site has a spectacular paid-member economy (ranks, points, streaks, IGNIS, Oracle) bolted to a beautiful anonymous brochure, with almost nothing bridging them — extend each member mechanic one step earlier into the anonymous funnel where conversion actually happens.

founderEvidence: Post-outage audit (founder asked 'do full website audit') after the apex self-loop incident was fixed. Three sub-agents covered security/reliability, perf/maintainability, and UX/feature/feedback/gamification/AI; supply-chain + secret scans clean.

items.summary: Visitors cast micro-votes ('Was this enough? Yes / I want more depth') but never see the loop close. The studio's whole brand is visible transparency, yet the one loop a visitor personally joined is hidden.
items.why: On-brand transparency no competitor does, on data that already exists. Showing 'you asked for depth on X — here's what we shipped' converts participation into trust and gives a reason to return.
items.recipe: Build a small /feedback/ strip (or homepage band) that joins existing feedback-insights.js vote data to the changelog: 'N people said more depth → we shipped the Oracle forecast panel.' Evidence: index.html:1166, membership/index.html:852 (data-micro-feedback-root).

items.summary: Ask IGNIS — the flagship AI demo of 'this studio is alive and intelligent' — is hard-gated to paying members. The exact conversion target (a curious first-timer) hits a sign-in wall before tasting it.
items.why: The single best proof of the studio's intelligence is locked from everyone who hasn't already paid. A taste-then-gate flow converts curiosity into the upgrade prompt the gate already renders.
items.recipe: Add a server-gated anonymous trial in the ask-ignis edge function: 2-3 questions/session rate-limited by IP, capped to Haiku (CANON-029 trial-ceiling), then the existing membership gate fires. Gate server-side, never client. Evidence: vault-oracle.js:436, games/index.html:927.

items.summary: The new post-deploy liveness gate turns a bad Worker deploy RED — but the broken Worker is already live on the route. Today's outage required a human to push a fix; recovery is fully manual.
items.why: Auto-rollback would have reverted today's outage in seconds instead of leaving prod hung until a manual fix. Highest-leverage remaining reliability gap.
items.recipe: Add an `if: failure()` step after the smoke gate in cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml that runs `wrangler rollback --env production` (non-interactive in CI) on the same CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN. Test the rollback command's CI confirmation behavior. Evidence: cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml:51-52.

items.summary: The rank economy is the SOUL's load-bearing feature, but a logged-out visitor sees only static tier names — the climb is described in prose, never felt.
items.why: A 30-second interactive climb makes the abstract 9-tier ladder tangible before commitment. Pure client-side; no backend.
items.recipe: Build a pre-signup rank simulator: visitor toggles activities (played a game, referred a friend) and watches a live point counter climb the ladder, ending on 'Create your free account to lock in Spark Initiate.' Evidence: membership/index.html:861, data-rank-projector.

items.summary: The Eternal tier's strongest hook — '$29.99 grandfather-locked for life as the vault grows' — is buried in fine print. It's the highest-converting framing on the page.
items.why: 'Lock this price forever before it rises' with live member-count urgency converts an existing written promise into active scarcity at near-zero cost.
items.recipe: Promote it to a live banner tied to the member count the homepage already pulls (proof-members): 'Eternal rate $29.99 — locked for life for the next N early members.' Evidence: membership/index.html:986, :1003.

items.summary: visit-depth.js tracks exploration in sessionStorage only, shows one upsell, then goes silent. A visitor who returns three times deeply exploring is treated identically to a first-timer.
items.why: Repeat un-converted visitors are the highest-intent, lowest-cost conversion pool, and the system literally forgets them between sessions. Escalating honest recognition of real return behavior is the most persuasive nudge available.
items.recipe: Promote section history to localStorage with a visit counter; on 2nd+ return escalate copy ('You've been back to the forge 3 times — lock in your rank'). Keep the voice-leak guard (no raw enums). Evidence: visit-depth.js:14.

items.summary: The IGNIS live score (0-100k) is beautiful but inert to an outsider — it never connects the number to anything a fan cares about.
items.why: Tying the velocity score to a concrete shipping forecast turns a vanity operator-metric into a reason to keep checking back (and to join for early access).
items.recipe: Add one derived line under the live gauge: 'At this velocity, [next sparked project] is forecast to ship in ~N weeks' — pull from the Oracle forecast data already generated (build-ignis-roi.mjs). Evidence: ignis/index.html score gauge.

items.summary: Games play on external domains (callofdoodie.wtf, target=_blank) with zero account hook. The highest-intent moment — someone actively playing — is disconnected from account creation. The funnel leaks at its strongest point.
items.why: The site spends enormous effort on rank/points lore but the moment a player cares most is untracked. Closing this loop turns players into ranked members when their intent peaks.
items.recipe: Add a 'connect your Vault account to bank these kills / save this league' return-link from game domains back to /vault-member/#register with ?from=cod attribution, awarding first Vault Points on signup. Evidence: games/index.html:663, :102.

items.summary: The homepage is a 1940-line wall of 14 always-rendered sections with a single 'Explore Our Games' hero CTA — no 'earn the next reveal' pacing.
items.why: A studio whose SOUL says membership 'feels like entry into something real' should make the homepage feel like descending into a vault, not scrolling a landing page. Pacing the reveal makes exploration itself the hook.
items.recipe: Introduce one progressive-disclosure beat: hold the deeper intelligence sections (Oracle/IGNIS/heartbeat) behind a 'Go deeper into the studio →' expander, OR reorder the pre-signup rank-climb directly under the hero as the primary scroll reward. Evidence: index.html (14 sections).

items.summary: All synthetic uptime runs from GitHub Actions datacenter IPs, which CF bot-challenges before the Worker — so no probe ever exercises a real browser-style HTML nav through the edge. The monitoring stack is structurally blind to the exact failure shape of 2026-06-08.
items.why: The whole point of uptime monitoring is catching the outage class it currently cannot see from a datacenter vantage.
items.recipe: Add a non-datacenter synthetic check — a CF Worker Cron from a different egress, or a free external browser monitor — that fetches the apex with a browser UA and asserts 200 + VaultSpark marker, alerting via the existing Resend capability. Evidence: uptime-probe.yml:17-18.

items.summary: 15 unreferenced ambient shell bundles (~1.56 MB) are git-tracked, and check-orphan-shell-assets.mjs is blind to them — the gate gives false confidence while shell-hash rotation cleanup silently fails.
items.why: Recurring pattern (shell_hash_rotation_cold_cache_cost). Removes 1.56 MB of dead bundles AND fixes a gate that was lying.
items.recipe: git rm the 15 unreferenced ambient*.shell-*.js, then extend check-orphan-shell-assets.mjs to glob ambient*.shell-*.js and cross-check shell-manifest.json + HTML so future rotations self-clean. Evidence: assets/ambient.shell-*.js (only 5 of 20 referenced).

items.summary: The edge portal gate, CSRF/rate-limit, and nonce-CSP all fail OPEN when their env flag isn't exactly '1'. A config slip during an env edit silently removes the edge defense layer with no warning.
items.why: Defense-in-depth that evaporates on a typo. The CSRF token machinery provides zero protection in the default-off state.
items.recipe: Move the required flags into version-controlled wrangler.toml [vars] (not dashboard-only) and add a smoke-live assertion that an unauthenticated gated path 302s to the sign-in surface (alarm if it 200s). Evidence: worker:718, :729, :755.

items.summary: Nothing rewards an anonymous visitor for returning daily before they make an account — the streak economy only exists post-signup. There's a return digest but no streak/saved trail.
items.why: Daily-return habit is the strongest predictor of conversion, and the site gives anonymous visitors zero reason to build it. A pre-account streak bridges 'interesting site' to 'thing I check.'
items.recipe: Add a pre-account 'daily Vault Signal' streak (localStorage flame lighting each distinct return day): 'Day 3 — create an account to make this permanent and earn real Vault Points.' Mirror the post-signup streak mechanic. Evidence: returning-visitor-digest.js, index.html:275.

items.summary: The ~800-line Worker (redirect tables, CSRF HMAC, rate-limit math, originFetch failover, nonce CSP) has zero unit/integration coverage — validated only by the live post-deploy smoke. A regression ships to prod and is caught only after it's live.
items.why: The self-loop class could reintroduce trivially (e.g. toOrigin rewriting to the apex). Catch it pre-deploy, not in production.
items.recipe: Add tests/worker.unit.spec.js under Miniflare/unstable_dev asserting: toOrigin never yields vaultsparkstudios.com host; a hanging primary fails over within the 8s bound; verifyCsrfToken rejects tampered/expired tokens. Wire into e2e.yml.

items.summary: /v/rum accepts unauthenticated wildcard-CORS POSTs, each doing an R2 put. No rate-limit: an attacker can flood it to inflate R2 cost AND poison the field-data that drives the perf-budget gates.
items.why: Cost-inflation + decision-data poisoning on an endpoint that feeds check-perf-budget --source=rum in build:check.
items.recipe: Apply the existing checkRateLimit (keyed by CF-Connecting-IP) to /v/rum and/or sample writes 1-in-N like the TT-report path. Cap daily R2 puts per IP. Evidence: worker:285-326, :255 (wildcard CORS).

items.summary: smoke-live's edge check passes on any non-5xx, so a Worker serving a 200 of WRONG content (failover serving origin content under the apex, or a 200 error page) would pass. It proves the edge answered, not that it answered correctly.
items.why: Tightens the gate I just shipped so it catches wrong-content-200, not just hang/5xx.
items.recipe: Assert the un-challenged JSON edge route (/api/founder-presence.json, already in EDGE_ROUTES) returns 200 + valid JSON + an expected key, not merely <500. Evidence: smoke-live.mjs:85-89.

items.summary: build:check chains 138 serial node spawns across 93 scripts, 47 of them paired --self-test + real-run = double cold Node startup per gate. ~6s of the ~7s wall time is pure process-spawn tax that scales linearly as gates are added.
items.why: The 100-gate pipeline's cost is startup overhead, not work. An in-process runner makes adding gates cheap again.
items.recipe: Batch the 47 --self-test runs into one in-process node scripts/run-selftests.mjs (imports + runs each), and wrap the independent --check gates in a Promise.all runner. Evidence: package.json build:check (138 node invocations).

items.summary: Internet-reachable edge functions return raw String(err) to clients (create-checkout:167, stripe-webhook:40/:271, assign-discord-role:144), leaking stack fragments / internal IDs / upstream messages for reconnaissance.
items.why: Information disclosure on unauthenticated endpoints; cheap to close.
items.recipe: Replace client-facing String(err) with a static 'Internal error' + a request-correlation id; keep detail in console.error only. Stripe-webhook signature-fail returns a bare 400.

items.summary: supabase/functions/odds uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while it proxies a metered paid Odds API key. Any third-party page + a leaked member JWT can burn paid quota (CANON-029).
items.why: Every other function pins origin; this one doesn't, and it's the one fronting a paid metered upstream.
items.recipe: Pin Access-Control-Allow-Origin to the env-driven allowed origin(s) + add Vary: Origin; verify per-user rate limiting on the upstream call. Evidence: odds/index.ts:21 vs create-checkout:38.

items.summary: 8 RUM gates run in build:check against data that can't yet fail (35 samples vs minSamples 50; siteState 'accumulating'). They're no-ops adding cold starts + noise.
items.why: Field LCP is healthy (p75 1588ms) but the gates are dormant; collapse them until data lands.
items.recipe: Collapse the 8 RUM gates into 1 conditional gate that early-exits when siteState === 'accumulating'. Evidence: .cache/rum-strict-ladder.json (totalSamples 35, sufficientRoutes 0).

items.summary: ~6 confirmed-dead one-shot codemods sit in scripts/ with zero references (fix-sentry-async, csp-meta-cleanup, defer-gtag, apply-s136-migration, migrate-products-to-redirects, inject-new-scripts).
items.why: Reduces the 219-script surface and the cognitive load of distinguishing live tooling from spent migrations.
items.recipe: Move confirmed one-shot codemods to scripts/archive/ (git-recoverable). Verify each is truly unreferenced in package.json + .github + .husky + sibling scripts first.

items.summary: 4 brand PNGs (~7 MB; 1.78-1.87 MB each) in assets/brand/ are referenced by zero HTML pages — unserved binary in the deployed artifact and git history.
items.why: Repo + artifact weight with no consumer; needs a quick founder check on whether they're /brand/ downloadables.
items.recipe: Confirm intent: if /brand/ downloadables, convert to WebP/AVIF + keep one hi-res; else remove. Evidence: logo-cinematic-dark.png, logo-primary-white.png, logo-primary-black.png (0 HTML refs).

items.summary: build:check cannot go green locally: at least one --check gate (build-ignis-search-index) reports 'stale' IMMEDIATELY after npm run build regenerated it, because the generator embeds non-deterministic data (timestamp/live state). sanitize-public-oracle-feed drifts the same way. (By priority this sits ~#12; added late after direct verification.)
items.why: A build gate that is randomly red trains the team to ignore build:check — which is part of why a real availability failure's signal was missed despite ~100 gates. An unreliable green/red signal is worse than fewer gates.
items.recipe: Make the generators deterministic in --check mode (strip/round timestamps, sort keys, freeze live-data inputs) OR split data-refresh artifacts out of the drift-checked set so only stable artifacts gate. Verify: run npm run build then build:check twice with no commit between — must stay green. Evidence: build-ignis-search-index --check stale post-build; sanitize-public-oracle-feed.mjs drift.

supabase-public.js is at index.html:1910 (end of body, after content), not a head render-blocker as first reported; adding defer changes execution ordering with minor upside — defer to a perf pass with testing, not worth the risk now.

config/csp-policy.mjs (imported by the Worker as WORKER_CSP) was not in the deploy workflow trigger paths, so CSP edits never redeployed. Added it to cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml paths.
ranks/index.html:149 linked to non-existent /vault-member/settings/. Repointed to /vault-member/ (portal, where the Profile & Settings tab lives) with corrected copy.

cloudflare-worker-deploy.yml auto-reverts (wrangler rollback --yes) + re-smokes when deploy succeeds but the liveness gate fails. Deployed + green in CI (run 27177181660). One YAML iteration (inline colon in --message broke the parse, fixed with a block scalar).

Adapted: edge JSON can't be asserted from CI (datacenter bot-challenge 403s it), so smoke-live now validates JSON artifacts (/api/founder-presence.json, /api/site-health.json) against the Pages origin. Self-test 12/12; live + CI green.
/v/rum rate-limited per CF-Connecting-IP (60/min, fails open if KV down). Live on prod (worker deploy green).

Redacted raw String(err)/${err} → static messages in create-checkout, stripe-webhook (signature + handler), assign-discord-role; detail kept in console.error. Code committed; requires `supabase functions deploy <name>` to go live (no CI deploy exists).

Wildcard CORS → env allowlist (ODDS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS) with Vary: Origin. Defaults to '*' when unset so the externally-hosted PromoGrind tool isn't broken by a deploy. Activation = set ODDS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS to the PromoGrind origin + supabase functions deploy odds. JWT+entitlement remains primary control.

Removed 12 unreferenced ambient bundles (1.18 MB). Rewrote check-orphan-shell-assets.mjs to be corpus-aware — fixed a DANGEROUS manifest-only false positive that suggested git rm on style/nav/theme hashes referenced by 18-20 pages, and added ambient coverage. Checker now clean.

Removed 8 spent one-shot migration scripts (render-product-pages, convert-webp, fix-sentry-async, csp-meta-cleanup, defer-gtag, inject-new-scripts, migrate-products-to-redirects, apply-s136-migration). Each verified referenced nowhere functional. validate-module-imports + lint-repo clean.
